Privacy Policy & Data Transparency

Last Audited & Updated: November 2026

1. Introduction

MONU COMPUTERS ("We", "Us", "Our", or "Platform") is committed to protecting your privacy, data security, and transparency. This Privacy Policy details how MONU COMPUTERS handles technical data, local browser storage, temporary server files, and third-party advertising services when you visit or use our online document, image, and PDF editing utilities.

2. Scope of This Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy applies to all pages, features, studio tools, and subdomains hosted under MONU COMPUTERS, including Document Studio, ID Card Studio, and Image & PDF Editor. It governs both in-browser client operations and short-lived temporary backend processing sessions.

3. Information We Collect

MONU COMPUTERS operates without user accounts or mandatory registration. Depending on how you interact with the Platform, we collect:

  • Technical Log Data: Standard HTTP request data logged by web hosting servers, including IP address, browser type, operating system, referring URL, date/time stamps, and request paths.
  • Temporary Upload Metadata: File name, file size, MIME format, and session validation tokens generated when you submit a file for server-side processing.
  • Support Inquiries: Name, email address, subject, and message content voluntarily provided when contacting us via email or contact form.

4. Information We Do Not Collect

Factually and strictly:

  • We do NOT require user registration, passwords, or personal profiles.
  • We do NOT extract, store, or sell personal identity information (e.g. Aadhaar, PAN, SSN, passport numbers) contained within documents you edit.
  • We do NOT maintain permanent server archives, user databases, or long-term file repositories of your documents or photos.

5. How We Use Information

Collected technical information is used strictly to:

  • Execute requested document enhancement, perspective warping, ID card framing, image compression, and PDF compilation tasks.
  • Maintain platform operational stability, diagnostic logging, abuse protection, and rate-limiting enforcement.
  • Deliver non-disruptive third-party advertisements via Google AdSense to keep our services free for all users.
  • Respond to user feedback, technical bug reports, and legal/privacy inquiries.

6. Image and Document Processing Architecture (Hybrid Model)

MONU COMPUTERS utilizes a dual processing architecture designed to maximize user privacy while ensuring high-performance capabilities. Processing operations are categorized into Browser-Based Execution and Temporary Backend Processing.

7. Browser-Based Processing (Client-Side Privacy)

Core image operations execute directly inside your device's web browser using HTML5 Canvas, WebGL, and OpenCV.js WebAssembly:

  • Uploaded files for browser-based operations remain entirely within your device memory.
  • No original image or processed output is transmitted to our servers during browser-side processing.
  • To prevent loss of ongoing work when switching tabs or refreshing, local canvas state, perspective corners, and recent project thumbnails are saved in your browser's local IndexedDB databases (Monu_DocIDStudio_DB and Monu_ImagePDFEditor_DB).
  • This persistent browser storage remains under your exclusive device control and can be cleared at any time using our built-in Data Control panel below or browser settings.

8. Temporary Backend Processing and Storage

For features that require temporary server processing:

  • A temporary backend processing session starts automatically ONLY after a file is uploaded to the server.
  • Every session is assigned a unique, unpredictable session identifier and security token.
  • All temporary backend sessions have a fixed maximum lifetime of 20 minutes (and a 10-minute inactivity limit).
  • Additional file uploads during an active session attach to the existing session but do NOT restart or extend the original 20-minute expiration time.
  • Expired sessions are blocked from accessing previous temporary file links or API endpoints.

9. Automatic File Deletion & Infrastructure Retention Disclosures

When a temporary backend session expires (after 20 minutes), an automated server background job permanently deletes all original uploaded files, processed outputs, thumbnails, and temporary session metadata.

Infrastructure Note: While files are purged from active server memory and storage immediately upon session expiration, standard server hosting ephemeral logs and system backup snapshots may retain encrypted system records for a limited technical period before automated overwriting, as dictated by cloud infrastructure retention schedules.

10. Manual File Deletion Methods

You maintain immediate control to delete files at any time:

  1. Backend Session Deletion: Click "🗑️ Delete Now" in the active session status bar during server processing. Upon confirmation, a purge request is sent to the server, instantly destroying temporary files and invalidating session tokens.
  2. Browser Data Clearing: Click "Clear All Saved Data & Reset Studio" in the panel above to instantly erase local IndexedDB cached documents, ID sets, and editor projects from your computer's browser storage.

11. Cookies and Web Storage Technologies

MONU COMPUTERS uses essential web storage (HTML5 LocalStorage, SessionStorage, IndexedDB) to manage application state and dark mode preferences. We do not use first-party tracking cookies to build personal user profiles.

12. Google AdSense & Advertising Partners

MONU COMPUTERS is monetized through advertisements served by Google AdSense and its advertising partners:

  • Google uses cookies (such as the DoubleClick cookie) to serve ads based on your visit to this site and other websites on the Internet.
  • Google's advertising cookies allow Google and its partners to serve personalized or non-personalized advertisements based on user browsing history.
  • You may opt out of personalized advertising at any time by visiting Google Ads Settings or www.aboutads.info.
  • Advertising networks do NOT receive access to your uploaded images, scanned documents, or processed files.

13. Web Analytics and Technical Diagnostics

We may measure platform usage trends using privacy-compliant server-side metrics or non-intrusive analytics. Technical diagnostics help us monitor bandwidth usage, detect broken features, optimize page load speed, and prevent security attacks.

14. Data Sharing and Disclosure

MONU COMPUTERS will NEVER sell, rent, trade, or monetize your documents, photos, personal information, or support messages to third parties. Data is disclosed only under strict legal necessity:

  • To comply with a valid court order, subpoena, or legally binding governmental request under applicable law.
  • To enforce our Terms and Conditions or protect platform security and infrastructure against malicious attacks.

15. Data Security Measures

We employ industry-standard technical security practices:

  • HTTPS/TLS encryption for all data in transit between your browser and our servers.
  • Unpredictable cryptographically generated session identifiers and validation tokens.
  • Server-side file type, file size, and payload validation to prevent malicious code execution.
  • Automated 10-second interval purge routines that eliminate expired backend sessions.

17. User Privacy Rights

In accordance with applicable privacy laws, including the Indian Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA), 2023, and international privacy standards such as GDPR where applicable, you have the right to:

  • Request confirmation regarding whether temporary server data associated with you is being processed.
  • Request immediate deletion or erasure of your temporary server session data via "Delete Now".
  • Clear all local browser-stored document data at any time via our built-in Data Control panel.
  • Withdraw consent or opt out of personalized advertising cookies via Google Ads Settings.
  • Lodge a privacy complaint or grievance with our designated Privacy Officer.

18. Children's Privacy

MONU COMPUTERS is a general utility site not directed to children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from individuals under applicable age thresholds (such as children under 13 in the US or minors without parental consent under Indian DPDPA rules). If you believe a child has submitted personal data through our support form, please contact us for immediate deletion.

19. International Data Transfers

Our web hosting servers and CDN nodes may process HTTP requests globally to ensure optimal latency. By using MONU COMPUTERS, you acknowledge that technical processing may occur on secure hosting infrastructure located in India or internationally, subject to standard cloud security protections.

20. Privacy Complaints and Grievance Redressal
